title: indigo_agent_mcp: embedded help bundle is stale and test_agent_mcp expects the previous driver version
description:
Registered on the owner's request of 2026-11-20; both defects confirmed on master at d411033ba.

1. Stale help bundle. python3 indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/generate_help.py --check exits 1 with 'MCP help bundle is stale'. The checked-in indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/indigo_agent_mcp_help.h is generated from indigo_docs/mcp/*.md, indigo_docs/mcp/agents/*.md and indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.md; those sources were changed by later commits (for example cbbc6aedf and 47da62f95 of 2026-11-20) without regenerating the header. A make build regenerates it, but the checked-in copy is what the Visual Studio build and a reader of the repository get, and nothing runs --check. Regenerate the header. Find which source documents changed since the last regeneration and report them. Add the --check run to an existing hardware-free test target (indigo_test buildsystem tests) so that a forgotten regeneration fails a test; establish first whether the Windows build has any way to regenerate the header and state the result.

2. Version assertion. indigo_test/integration/test_agent_mcp.c:211 asserts info.version == 0x03000003 while indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/indigo_agent_mcp.c:42 defines DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000004 (raised by 85313ca07 of 2026-11-10), so the case 'idempotent automatic lifecycle' of make -C indigo_test test-agent-mcp fails. Reported during ticket e4cfbebb, not re-run since. Reproduce with test-agent-mcp, find out whether anything besides the stale constant fails, and fix the test; prefer not to hard-code a literal that must be edited with every version bump if the surrounding tests have a convention for it.

If the fix changes the behaviour of the driver, increment DRIVER_VERSION; regenerating the help header from changed documents changes what the agent serves, so decide and justify whether that counts. Do not edit README files. Verification: generate_help.py --check exits 0, test-agent-mcp and test-agent-mcp-sanitize pass with counts reported, test-buildsystem passes.
